title: Naixin Wang
text:
MSc Artificial Intelligence | Leiden University
Welcome to my personal website!
I am currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Artificial Intelligence at Leiden University. I hold a Bachelor’s degree in Physics from Shanghai Normal University and have professional experience in Data Science and Machine Learning.
My current interests include Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, and Machine Learning, particularly in developing and evaluating intelligent systems.
